claim: Sampling numerical contract and report-safety evidence independently reviewed; saved GPU results were checked for coverage, thresholds and current identity, not rerun by this review

full_kernel_coordinate_context.method: Independent cuobjdump CPU invocation for four complete original sm120/ported sm86 pre/post functions, then source-byte SHA checks at all selected offsets

legacy_pre_diagnostic.scope: Artificial historical setup without FTZ multiplication; retained for diagnostic compatibility. This is not evidence of the complete original pre arithmetic.

authentic_pre_context.scope: Original Catmull slice with upstream mul.ftz restored; complete pre machine code independently confirms fusion. The probe remains a re-JIT sampling slice, not the complete pre neural kernel.

complete_post_reference.source: Current local sm86 cubin, full original post kernel launched through klab, zero neural weights, blend=1: 2*RGB recovers history sampling

sampling.baseline_name: Legacy bilinear/Catmull sampler under the current Reset contract; not a replay of the complete batch3 network
sampling.baseline_scope_correct: Current Reset contract plus legacy sampler; not a replay of the complete old network

hardware_reciprocal.cpu_fallback: Ordinary reciprocal only; not CUDA numerical parity
static_review: Caches module/function by active CUDA context and retains modules for graph lifetime
Cold graph compilation explicitly rejected; warmup compiles outside capture
Launch uses the current Torch CUDA stream and records input stream lifetime
Driver errors propagate; CUDA errors never choose the CPU fallback

sampling.partial_and_coverage_contract: Partial execution sets complete=false and passed=false, with requested_suite_passed separately recorded; full acceptance requires 16 probes, 9 complete post cases, 20 network rows and Graph

reviewed_behaviors: Report and .tmp direct/hardlink aliases to declared source/runtime/reference inputs are rejected before writes
Capture containment and outside hardlinks are both protected
Dynamic references are registered before reading and revalidated at acceptance finish
Exclusive creation preserves pre-existing foreign temporary files
Serialization happens before creating temporary output; failed writes remove only a temporary file whose inode belongs to this call
Adapters protect verify_assets, transfer host inputs, temporal captures and acceptance references

limitations: Selected scalar FFMA/RCP and finite synthetic cases do not prove native sm120 MMA or whole-product parity
Measured texture coordinate/cross-weight precision remains specific to the recorded RTX3060
Reviewer performed CPU/static tests only; saved GPU numerical measurements belong to the separately identified execution report
